name: EdEE (Custom HumHub) API
description:
This is the official REST API documentation for **EdEE**, a customized platform built on top of the HumHub framework.  
The API extends HumHub’s core functionalities to support EdEE’s specific use cases, including enhanced post management,  
event handling, membership logic, notifications, and user engagement features.

All endpoints follow REST conventions and return responses in a standardized JSON format for easy integration  
with mobile apps, SDKs, and external systems.

🔐 **Note:** Most endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.  
⚙️ **Tip:** Use the “Authorize” button in the Swagger UI to provide your token before testing endpoints.
